Bash(# Create game and join to see full fieldEffects
GAME_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/game/player/startGame -H ""Content-Type: application/json"" -d ''{""playerId"": ""playerId_1""}'')
GAME_ID=$(echo $GAME_RESPONSE | jq -r ''.gameId'')
echo ""Created game: $GAME_ID""

# Join and save response
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/game/player/joinRoom -H ""Content-Type: application/json"" -d ""{\""playerId\"": \""playerId_2\"", \""gameId\"": \""$GAME_ID\""}"" | jq ''.gameEnv.fieldEffects'' > /tmp/fieldEffects.json

echo ""FieldEffects content:""
cat /tmp/fieldEffects.json)
